notes: v0.19.2: Adds an optional, OFF-BY-DEFAULT, experimental Shizuku-free Quest tracking mode using Android system folder picker and persisted read-only permission for Documents/Logs. Existing Shizuku tracking remains the recommended default and can be restored without unlinking. The Quest app-UID folder watcher parses incremental VRChat join/leave/instance events, uses the same durable SQLite queue and Relay authentication, and never uploads raw logs. Quest folder-picker availability and concurrent background monitoring are NOT yet confirmed by headset testing. Existing Quest pinned tabs, Quest 2/3 Shizuku functionality, ordinary Android phone UI, signing key, and GM4/GM1 authority remain unchanged. No Main Launcher or Relay deployment changes.
